dataset.source_reference: Frangieh et al., Nature Genetics 2021, SCP1064; scPerturb RNA harmonization distributed by scverse/pertpy

preprocessing.normalization: per-cell counts per 10000 followed by log1p
preprocessing.response: perturbation-context mean minus matched context control mean
preprocessing.response_gene_axis: intersection with frozen internal generalization_factorial/common_response_genes.txt, then exclude every primary-pair perturbation target
preprocessing.low_cell_robustness: evaluate the same frozen predictions on targets above the pre-performance 25th percentile of paired-context minimum cell count

context_pair_selection.rule: maximum shared perturbations passing the frozen cell threshold; adequate matched controls; biologically distinct

verdict_rules.direction_clear: primary ALIGNED_MINUS_SHUFFLE_90 estimate >= 0.05, paired CI lower > 0, and >=4/5 seed differences positive
verdict_rules.identity_replicated: direction_clear in both directions, aligned mean > shuffled mean at >=4/6 coverage levels in both directions, and HIGH_CELL_TARGETS ALIGNED_MINUS_SHUFFLE_90 CI lower > 0 in both directions
verdict_rules.identity_partial: direction_clear in exactly one direction, or both directions positive with at least one uncertain
verdict_rules.identity_not_replicated: primary ALIGNED_MINUS_SHUFFLE_90 CI upper < 0.05 in both directions
verdict_rules.overall: without an accessible zero-shot branch, successful identity replication yields GENERALIZATION_AXIS_ASYMMETRY_EXTERNAL_PARTIAL
